images.caption: A wildstyle throw-up in green, red, and white sits low along the BNSF 492646 side, layered blocky letters with a touch of character work. It reads as a proper multi-color piece against the maroon panel.

A green and brown BNSF boxcar is centered on the track, featuring a long, multi-colored throw-up in white, red, and blue with black outlines running along the lower panel. The piece is a standard letter-based piece with a colorful fill.

A green and brown BNSF boxcar 270045 is centered on the track, featuring a long, multi-colored throw-up in white, red, and blue with black outlines running along the lower panel. The piece is a standard letter-based piece with a colorful fill.
A yellow and black piece on a GATX WBRK 9348 hopper pairs a big yellow letter run with a stenciled character figure and face in the center. The GATX road name reads clean on the right.
A composed piece with a sun-burst character and red-and-blue lettering fills the lower panel of a rust-red hopper, with a circular logo on the upper right. The hopper is lettered GGCX 55 0222.

A striking monochrome piece covers the side of COER boxcar 311668, its large black letterforms set against a cracked, marble-like grey ground that fills the whole panel. The high-contrast, composed design reads as intentional art rather than a quick tag, a standout piece on the train.

A multi-color piece on a BNSF 473110 hopper features a green character with a face next to stylized orange and blue lettering. The artwork is composed and intentional, with a distinct character element.

A bold white and green throw-up spelling 'SURB' with a stylized face character worked into the lettering dominates the side of a maroon BNSF hopper 481957. The piece reads clean against the factory paint, with a BNSF unit trailing behind on the left.

The same composed character piece on BNSF hopper 475253 — a sunglasses-wearing figure with a raised fist in grey, white, and red, plus a circular emblem — is fully in frame here. The intentional imagery stands out on the dark red panel.
A composed botanical mural of green leaves and pale blossoms sweeps the lower half of a brown BNSF boxcar 476708, framed by white GATX hoppers on either side, the round road symbol untouched above.

A mustard-yellow TTX intermodal well car carries a composed piece along its lower half: a row of colorful character and figure work in blues, greens, and pinks running the length of the panel, set against the dark TTX door. The car is lettered TTX 78 0X 63 93.
The same green and yellow wildstyle piece with a character figure is now centered in frame on a WFRX boxcar lettered 806113. A blue and green tag sits on the car to the right.
A green leafy mural with pale flower accents is painted across the lower side of a brown BNSF boxcar, a picture-first piece that pops against the dark body, with a white COER hopper at right.

A composed, multi-color piece on a grey Ferromex boxcar (TTGX 803445) pairs orange and purple wildstyle lettering with a row of small white character figures and a blue wave motif along the lower panel. The whole side is visible against the lake and pines under a heavy overcast sky.
Big bold KAFIA lettering in dark maroon on a pale green field wraps the whole side of a BNSF 488858 hopper, a clean, intentional full-panel piece. The lake and far hills sit behind it.

A bold multi-color throw-up spelling a stylized word in pink, grey, and black block letters fills the whole side of this white boxcar 85202, the piece the camera exists for. The letters are large, composed, and unmissable.

A white and red letter piece with a dark character or imagery worked into the center is painted across the side of a white COER boxcar. The composition reads as a deliberate multi-color piece rather than a quick tag.

A pink and white letter piece with a small character element sits on a grey auto-carrier, backed by a blue throw-up on the adjacent orange car. The train rolls past a lake with a forested far shore under a grey sky.

A composed yellow-and-white letter piece on a maroon BNSF boxcar 485437 works a small blue cartoon character with a round face and antenna into the center of the lettering, giving the throw-up a deliberate, character-driven look. The imagery is the hook that lifts it above a routine piece.

A dark hopper marked MRL 51053 carries a composed piece of pink and white angular shapes and a large central triangle, the geometric design filling the lower body. It passes a lake with a snow-capped peak on the horizon.

A bold yellow and blue wildstyle piece with tight linework and a small character element fills the left panel of this white GATX intermodal well car, reporting marks COER 352911. A plain white well car sits to the right.

A cream hopper holds a composed piece: a blue cartoon character with a rounded face and eyes flanked by a yellow-orange bubble-letter piece and a small 'Coffee' logo. The character work makes it a standout pictorial-letters piece.
A BNSF boxcar, 485894, is covered in a yellow and green wildstyle piece with a clean white panda face worked into the lettering. The character face lifts it above a standard throw-up.
A COER boxcar, 723456, wears a yellow and blue piece reading 'FIRE EAGLE' with two small white face characters flanking the text. Bright, composed, and easy to read.

A large, multi-colored piece with purple and blue wildstyle lettering and a spiked, flame-like lower fill runs along the bottom of a grey boxcar. The car sits on a track by a body of water with a forested hillside behind it.

A boxcar with a 'CN' logo and a large, multi-colored piece of graffiti featuring stylized characters and imagery along the bottom. The piece is a more complex work of art on a tan car, with green and white colors.

A Kansas City Southern boxcar with a 'Building America' logo and a piece of graffiti that includes stylized characters or imagery along the bottom. The piece is a mix of letters and shapes on a tan car.
A multi-color piece with peach and teal letters and a character element covers the side of a TILX hopper. The car is a TILX 541100, passing along a lakeside cut.
A multi-color piece with peach and teal letters and a character element covers the side of a TILX hopper. The car is a TILX 540908, passing along a lakeside cut.
A bold, dark throw-up with pink and purple accents covers the side of an AGPX hopper, the piece's letters reading roughly 'SAGA'. It sits on a tree-lined track beside a calm lake.
